scheme_name: Coir Vikas Yojana- Export Market Promotion Scheme
other_conditions: Must be registered with the Coir Board
Must be a micro, small or medium enterprise engaged in coir or coir products
Should not have availed similar financial assistance from any other source for the same purpose
Should not be charged, debarred, prosecuted, or blacklisted under the Foreign Trade Policy of the Government of India or by the Coir Board
If prior financial assistance from the Coir Board was received for the same purpose, that amount will be deducted from the eligible assistance
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for participation in international fairs, seminars, and related export activities, covering travel, exhibition space, and freight costs.
